scope: Phase 1 source provenance and structural audit only

provenance_context.data_design: observational; no randomized allocation or controlled intervention
provenance_context.collection_method: Authors describe sampling user IDs from public Amazon pages and collecting associated review pages; this does not establish random sampling of buyers/products.

observation_units.review: One collected review record; not one guaranteed distinct purchase
observation_units.meta: One collected product metadata record; uniqueness is audited, not assumed

limits: Review writing and helpful voting are self-selected user activities.
Item review histories may be incomplete, including recently posted reviews before cutoff.
Helpful counts have unequal exposure and accumulation time; impressions/vote event times are absent.
Metadata is a crawl-time snapshot; price and rating aggregates are not historical versions.
File-category membership and metadata main_category are distinct fields.
Collected review counts do not measure all purchases, returns, defects, or causal effects.
provenance_context.global_documented_review_period: May 1996 to September 2023; local ranges are measured separately
provenance_context.metadata_time_range: Not derivable from these files without a documented timestamp/version history
